components.description: One academic term of paid parental leave for faculty members, for either parent after a birth, adoption or foster placement, taken within the first year; only one of two University-employed parents may use it.
components.eligible_parent_wording: new parents; faculty members; delivery, adoption or placement for foster care; birth mother (for the coordination with short-term disability)
components.service_requirement: none stated for eligibility; a member employed less than one full academic year in a benefited faculty position before the leave must complete a full academic year after it or reimburse the salary received
components.entitlement_note: 'provides' states the leave as an entitlement; the notification paragraph adds 'leave will be granted' where notice is not possible.
components.duration_note: 'one academic term'; the documents do not define the academic term's length or kind (see flag).
components.medical_certification_note: How to Apply: a doctor or health care provider must complete the Certification of Health Care Provider Form.
components.dual_employee_rule: either may utilize the paid Parental Leave, but not both
components.time_window: within the first year after delivery, adoption or placement for foster care
components.notice: whenever possible, inform chair or dean no later than three months before the proposed beginning of leave
components.return_obligation: return at the same status and work the following academic term, else reimburse the health insurance premium and paid parental leave paid during the leave (except for a continued serious health condition); members with under one full academic year of prior service must complete a full academic year after the leave or reimburse the salary
components.relief_note: A leave; no duties stated (R9). Time on parental leave counts as a term of service for sabbatical eligibility.

notes: The rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3) does not apply. 2018_02 (University Policy Manual 3.30.010, Leaves of Absence and Vacation) is a governing leave policy covering faculty, and 2018_01 (APT policies, Board-approved 2015) is a governing faculty document with a tenure-clock provision (5.5.3.F). missing = false.

Source status of the faculty parental leave: the Faculty Parental Leave text appears only on the HR 'Leaves of Absence' page (2018_00), but it is presented as the 'Guidelines and Procedures' themselves (General Provisions, Terms of Eligibility, Notification, Simultaneous Leave, Faculty Status After Leave, Tenure Probationary Period, Sabbatical Leave, How to Apply, with an interpretation clause), not as a summary of another document. Read as the governing guideline; not flagged summary_only. A lead may wish to confirm this reading.

Calendar: no document states the term length or the kind of term. APT 5.5.7 refers to 'the second academic quarter or semester' and 'the third academic quarter'; this does not fix the institution's calendar, so no calendar is recorded and c1's 'one academic term' is converted by R8's order (flagged ambiguous on c1).

Pay level of the faculty parental leave is not stated ('paid parental leave'); pay_fraction left empty. The staff schedule's percentages apply to staff only. For a birth mother the faculty leave runs 'in conjunction with' the Core Short Term Disability Benefit, whose terms (length, pay, funding) are not saved.

Birth parent chain: faculty paid parental leave, one academic term (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from its start (c4 concurrent_with c1) and the Core STD benefit alongside (c5 concurrent_with c1); tenure-clock extension on request (c2).

Non-birth parent chain: faculty paid parental leave, one academic term (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside (c4 concurrent_with c1); only one of two University-employed parents may use the paid leave.

Not components: faculty vacation ('Faculty members do not accrue vacation leave, but instead take vacation time as needed when the demands of their academic schedules permit': no balance or leave entitlement); bereavement and jury duty leave (not usable for a birth); FMLA military family provisions (C4 not_components); sabbatical crediting of parental leave (recorded in c1 relief_note); APT 5.5.4.E discretionary delay of a tenure decision 'under special circumstances' (not a leave-related clock stop); 'leave which the University determines may be legally required' for disability accommodation (part of Discretionary Leave, c7; no statute named).
Policy Manual 3.30.010 is dated 3/18/95 and was captured 2018-03-28; read as in force on the reference date. The HR page (captured 2018-03-27) restates its Discretionary Leave and vacation text.

Documents cited but not saved: Core Short Term Disability Benefit plan (The Hartford); Parental Leave Pay Schedule (Leave Forms, Benefits & Compensation tab); FMLA-Understanding Your Rights & University of Denver Guidelines; Leave of Absence Communication Form; Certification of Health Care Provider Form; Department of Labor Q&A; union contracts (Policy 3.30.010 I); University Policy Manual on Emeritus status and Faculty Senate Constitution (APT; not leave-related); Affirmative Action Plan (APT 3.2; not leave-related).
